sources.observation: The corporate structure page names Banco Mercantil del Norte, S.A., Institución de Banca Múltiple, Grupo Financiero Banorte as an authorized Mexican credit institution; its header SVG is labeled Grupo Financiero Banorte. The page includes 2026 press-release navigation. The vector contains a red three-path emblem, white group name and a dark rectangular background. This is a current site observation, not a logo-launch date.

Google Play lists Banorte Móvil by Banorte Mobile Team, identifies Banco Mercantil del Norte as developer, and displays an update date of 9 November 2026. The inspected app artwork shows the Banorte name and a white emblem with upper ellipse, split lower ellipse and tapered negative-space wedge on a red 125th-anniversary design. Its distinctive structure matches the investor vector, but its colors and presentation differ; it does not verify exact geometry or official circular use of the red variant.
